data.name: Boopalan
data.gender_notes: Boopalan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Boopalan is a Tamil and Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Boopa' meaning Lord, and 'Alan' meaning boons. The name Boopalan signifies the one who bestows blessings and good fortune upon his devotees. The name Boopalan carries the meaning “Lord of Boons” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Boopalan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of boons and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Boopalan is a revered name among the Hindu community. It is believed that invoking the name of Lord Boopalan brings peace, wisdom, and strength. The name is also associated with the deity Lord Ayyappan, who is known for his benevolence and power.
data.etymology: Boopalan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Boons.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Boopalan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
